token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `chat:write` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel_id.desc: ID of the channel containing the agent session. Required for public channels.

title.desc: New title for the agent session (1-200 characters). For a session channel, this also renames the channel.

thread_ts.desc: Timestamp of the thread root message the session is scoped to. Required for thread-based sessions in regular channels and DMs. Must be omitted for session channels.

title.desc: The updated title of the agent session.

channel_id.desc: The encoded ID of the channel, returned when an agent channel was renamed.

feature_disabled.desc: The agent tasks feature is not enabled for this workspace.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel does not exist or is not accessible.

not_authorized.desc: The calling app is not an authorized agent for this session.

session_not_found.desc: No agent session exists for the specified channel and thread.

thread_ts_required.desc: `thread_ts` is required for thread-based sessions in regular channels and DMs.

thread_ts_not_allowed.desc: `thread_ts` must not be provided for session channels.

invalid_name.desc: The `title` value is not valid for a channel name.

name_taken.desc: The new channel name is already taken.

internal_error.desc: An internal error occurred while renaming the session.
